COSMIC PINBALL · V26

COSMIC
PINBALL.

← → control both flippers on that side.
Space launches each ball.
A toggles auto flippers.
P pauses. R restarts.

Hit all three bumpers to increase your multiplier. Shoot upward into either glowing ramp entrance for a 500-point return.

Configurable ball count. High score lasts until this page closes. Raised ramps use guided travel; the rest of the table uses ball physics.

Small bumpers: 50 points × multiplier. The three large bumpers advance the multiplier, capped by Max Multiplier. The purple diverter swings clockwise one second after launch.

Trap: small pocket, 50% capture chance on entry at moderate speed. One bonus per numbered ball. Launch / Space starts it immediately, or wait five seconds. The trapped ball releases three seconds later. Both balls must drain before the next numbered ball; bonus balls do not consume the numbered-ball allowance. Pause freezes all timers.

Game settings

Applying settings starts a new round and clears the session high score.
